### Notice: Setting up Drago for your profile?

If you are setting up Drago for your personal profile, **please DO NOT submit a pull request!**

Your dragon lives directly in your own forked repository (`<your-username>/drago`). You do not need to merge anything back into this upstream repository. Simply paste your raw image link into your profile README:

```markdown
<p align="center">
  <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<YOUR_USERNAME>/drago/main/assets/dragon.gif" width="650" alt="My Evolving Dragon">
  <br>
  <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<YOUR_USERNAME>/drago/main/assets/dragon-status.svg" width="650" alt="Drago Status Card">
</p>
```
